claim: In the matching retail DLL, three small raw geometry/classifier methods used by FACT-0050 are closed as one caller-connected family. MatchMisc.IsArea_UpperTriangles (0x06004961) has an exact 18-byte Boolean body: it returns true when raw area equals 2 or 3 and false for every other raw value. Ring.GetColAreaInRhombus (0x060050E8) has parameters rp, x and y and an exact 44-byte body using emitted unordered-capable Float32 branches against rp.y2 and rp.x2: on ordered values, y>=rp.y2 returns raw 2 when x<=rp.x2 and raw 3 when x>rp.x2, while y<rp.y2 returns raw 4 when x<=rp.x2 and raw 5 when x>rp.x2. Ring.GetColAreaInRhombus_AroundRing (0x060050E9) is an exact 26-byte instance wrapper that loads colData_AroundRing, forwards p.x and p.y to GetColAreaInRhombus, and returns the raw result. FACT-0050 pins the around-ring wrapper call at TransitStateAfterAnm_AutoRun IL+0x0062 and four IsArea_UpperTriangles calls at IL+0x0095, 0x00B8, 0x00F0 and 0x0113.
